correctness.rationale: Every labelled order-4 Latin square is four mutually column-disjoint permutation rows; independent enumeration gives exactly 576. Partition into two row-pairs and column-pairs; at a square with four 2x2 intercalates, four independent block switches form a 16-square cube. Alternating signs cancel every event querying at most three distinct cells because an untouched block remains, yielding 54 annihilating measures. Independent enumeration gave 54 distinct cubes; the 432 squares in exactly one cube and 144 in three cubes give eight private squares per cube, proving independence. The actual supplied pivot_manifest lists 522 columns of degree<=3 and 54 additional degree-4 columns; independent GF(5) elimination of all degree<=3 columns and those actual 54 degree-4 witnesses produced ranks [1,28,246,522,576]. A mod-5 independent set yields real independence of the integral event columns; together with cube nullity upper bound and 576-row bound, this certifies exact real ranks. The signed annihilators have total mass zero so their positive/negative parts show true distribution ambiguity.
